FX-GRADE4-001.says: Every setting as added, sharpen written at 0: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE4-002.says: Sharpen 100: each colour pushed away from its 1-pixel blur, so the edges between the colour columns harder; flat runs untouched.

FX-GRADE4-004.says: Sharpen -100: each colour its 1-pixel blur, the drawing softened.

FX-GRADE4-005.says: Sharpen -40: four tenths of the way to the blur.

FX-GRADE4-006.says: Sharpen keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the blur at frame 0, the drawing at frame 2, FX-GRADE4-002 at frame 4.

FX-GRADE4-007.says: Faded film 40, sharpen 80, vibrance 50: the sharpen works on the faded colours and the vibrance on the sharpened ones, in that order.

FX-GRADE4-008.says: Sharpen 60 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-GRADE4-009.says: A dark vignette (amount -3, feather 20) at roundness -100: a rectangle the layer's shape, so the corners darken no more than the edges' middles.

FX-GRADE4-010.says: The same at roundness -50: between the rectangle and roundness 0's ellipse, the corners a little darker than the edges' middles.

FX-GRADE4-011.says: A light vignette (amount 2, midpoint 20, feather 10) at roundness -20: just squarer than roundness 0.

FX-GRADE4-012.says: FX-GRADE4-009's vignette with roundness keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the rectangle, roundness 0's ellipse, a circle.

FX-GRADE4-013.says: A whole grade with sharpen 30 and roundness -60, every section in its order.

FX-GRADE4-014.says: A D-571 file without sharpen, a strong vignette: D-571's own picture.

FX-GRADE4-015.says: Sharpen 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE4-016.says: Sharpen -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
